performance.title: MAIN STAGE | Our Town
performance.description:
FALL MAIN STAGE 2026 | NO LATE SEATING

Written By Thornton Wilder | Directed by Guest Artist Jeffrey Lo

A Stage Manager enters before us calling for time. But it’s not a rehearsal they are calling us in for, it’s real life. In Thornton Wilder’s masterwork Our Town we experience life in three acts: “Daily Life,” “Love and Marriage” and finally, “Death and Eternity.” In a world where the possibility of humanity losing its grasp on reality looms large, the resonance of this classic reverberates today as strongly as it did when first written and in one of those most stunning scenes in the American canon, we come face to face with what it is we have already lost.

Hailed by Edward Albee as “the greatest American play ever written,” this enduring story continues to ask us—generations later—how to use our time, how to love our time and how to run out of time.

exhibit.title: Branner Library Book & Map Exhibit - Water in the West
exhibit.room_number: Branner Earth Sciences Library & Map Collections
exhibit.description:
Branner Earth Sciences Library & Map Collection Exhibit:

Water in the West

Our Fall 2026 exhibition highlights the water resources in California & the Western United States to shed light on the issues that affect our waterways.

The exhibit features maps and the Layperson’s guides series published by the Water Education Foundation, which aim to foster public understanding of water resources. 

These resources help inform collaborative decision-making to build collective solutions for water issues across the Western United States.

The exhibit is available for viewing Monday through Friday during regular library open hours. 

Check out past exhibits and subscribe to the Branner Library Newsletter.  

A current Stanford ID is needed to enter the library, visitors must present a valid, physical government-issued photo ID to sign-in at the front desk.

drawingSourceOffering.Name: 11/21 The Magic of Drawing Workshop
drawingSourceOffering.Summary: If you are a beginner or already draw, this class will teach you the magic, everything from the simple basics, to easy techniques you can use to enhance your drawing skills so you can feel confident to express yourself drawing any subject.

Description.Text:
If you are a beginner or already draw, this class will teach you the magic, everything from the simple basics, to easy techniques you can use to enhance your drawing skills so you can feel confident to express yourself drawing any subject. In this workshop you will learn how to:

- Draw quickly
- Capture essence
- Simplify
- Draw people, architecture, and most anything
- Seven ways to create the illusion of three dimensional space and form
- Draw freehand perspective
- Overlap images
- Stay relaxed and have a lot of fun drawing

In this hands-on class you will learn how to practice to improve your drawing skills quickly. You will learn how to develop concentration, increase perception, self-awareness, and express your creativity drawing. During this well-planned one day workshop you will watch your skill unfold easily like magic. This workshop will prepare you for a lifetime of drawing pleasure.  Whether you are traveling, vacationing, on a weekend outing, or drawing at home, you will easily be able to incorporate these skills.  Beginners and more advanced students are welcome.

A $10 materials fee due to the instructor at the start of class.

If you are a beginner or already draw, this class will teach you the magic, everything from the simple basics, to easy techniques you can use to enhance your drawing skills so you can feel confident to express yourself drawing any subject. In this workshop you will learn how to:

- Stay relaxed and have a lot of fun drawing

In this hands-on class you will learn how to practice to improve your drawing skills quickly. You will learn how to develop concentration, increase perception, self-awareness, and express your creativity drawing. During this well-planned one day workshop you will watch your skill unfold easily like magic. This workshop will prepare you for a lifetime of drawing pleasure.  Whether you are traveling, vacationing, on a weekend outing, or drawing at home, you will easily be able to incorporate these skills.  Beginners and more advanced students are welcome.

Robert Regis Dvořák has been showing people how to have fun drawing and painting for over 30 years. He is a watercolor artist and public speaker on the subject of creativity in education and business.  He has worked as an architectural designer and is a former professor of architecture at the Universities of Oregon and California, Berkeley.  He is the author of six books on drawing and painting:  The Practice of Drawing as Meditation, Drawing Without Fear, Experiential Drawing, The Magic of Drawing, Travel Drawing and Painting, and The Pocket Drawing Book.
A $10 materials fee due to the instructor at the start of class. All materials will be provided.
